boost_combat_arts.where: Smyrnos's Temple, Hightown, Dagsion. Temple Reception > Divine Service > Boost Combat Arts.
boost_combat_arts.availability: Dietrich's path only in Part I. Tutorial in Dietrich Ch 4 (RPG Site). RPG Site: Dietrich's team is the only party that can upgrade Combat Arts in Part I.
boost_combat_arts.currency: Magic Echo Shards (RPG Site also calls them Magic Echo Stones).
how_to_earn_shards: Use Answerer's Cry on the world map (Dietrich's hero talent, from Ch 4) to reveal hidden enemies, then beat them in a Skirmish. Only enemies with an item-bag icon drop shards; revealed enemies vanish if not reached within 2 turns (Game8).
Repeated Answerer's Cry uses shrink its radius; it recovers over time or on entering/leaving a base or dungeon (fortunesweave.online).
50 shards granted as a trial when Teach Secrets first unlocks (Game8 Skirmish Guide, via search excerpt; not read directly).
boost_combat_arts.per_upgrade: Pick a unit and one of that unit's Combat Arts; the upgrade raises one of the art's stats (Game8 Dietrich page). Upgrades can raise Hit, Crit, or cut durability cost (Game8 Magic Echo Shards page). The result is a '+' version, e.g. Gale Spear -> Gale Spear+ (AllThings.How). Not every art can be upgraded (Game8).
boost_combat_arts.priority_advice: Game8: reduce durability cost first, then Hit and Crit.

cost.resolution: Not a real conflict. AllThings.How says the cheapest options cost 20 shards each, which implies costs vary by art. RPG Site says about 400 shards for the 10 upgrades the Blacksmith unlock needs, so an average near 40 per upgrade. Both can be true. RPG Site's ~400 is the planning number; the exact cost of each art's upgrade is not documented.

boost_combat_arts.blacksmith_unlock: Boost 10 or more distinct Combat Arts, then talk to the temple caretaker for the Smyrnos scene and 'Class Unlocked: Blacksmith' (AllThings.How; RPG Site). Local notes add Renown 8 and Smyrnos Bless Lv 1. The unlock is account-wide.
open_questions: Whether a '+' art can be boosted again.
Which stat each specific art's boost changes.
Whether boosts carry to other paths or Part III.

teach_secrets.where: Same Temple Reception at Smyrnos's Temple, 'Teach Secrets' option.
teach_secrets.unlocks: Dietrich's Part I Ch 7 (tutorial at chapter start).
teach_secrets.what_can_be_taught: Only the Hidden (secret) arts Dietrich won from Dread Warriors. Arts learned any other way must be learned normally by each unit (Game8).
teach_secrets.who_can_learn: Any ally on Dietrich's route (Game8, RPG Site). The learner still needs the matching weapon type to use it (e.g. Hidden Windpierce needs a 1-2 range spear).
teach_secrets.cost: Magic Echo Shards; amount per art not documented.

other_sources_of_arts.detail: Raising a weapon's skill rank teaches arts; lists differ per character. Game8 character pages list each unit's arts without ranks.

Some weapons carry an art usable while equipped (Killing Edge: Deadly Blade, Longbow: Deadeye, Levin Sword: Lightning Strike, Ji: Windweave, Star Spear: Blinding Starlight, Salamander/Zerberus: Compressed Laser, and more).
Da Mina Sword/Spear grant Hit+10 when attacking with a combat art (Serenes Forest).
Combat Arts can be inherited when merging Part I versions of a character into a Part III unit (fortunesweave.co.uk, marked unverified).

combat_art_slots.class_bonus: Class skills 'Combat Arts +1/+2/+3' add equippable art slots while in that class (class-data.json).
combat_art_slots.observation: AllThings.How's Theodora Guardian build (Combat Arts +2) lists six equipped arts, which would put the base at four if that list is complete. Not confirmed.

other_abilities.skill_rank_notes: Unlocked on reaching a skill grade (Game8, Fextralife). Weapon and magic ladders are the same for every unit: Lv. 1 at D+, Lv. 2 at C+, Lv. 3 at B+, Lv. 4 at A+, Lv. 5 at S, -faire/-Mastery at S+ (Game8). Riding (D Knightly Senses, C+ Vanguard, A Cavalry Move, S Vanguard+, S+ Cavalry Move+) and Flying (D Read the Winds, C+ Flitting Flier, A Airfighter, S Flitting Flier+, S+ Airfighter+) look universal (community sheet). Infantry, Heavy Armor and Authority abilities differ per character; 'rank' gives the usual grade and the per-unit rows are in character-learnsets.json. The community sheet uses whole-letter grade columns, so a sheet D may mean D or D+. universal=false means per character. Abilities with a movement tag (Infantry, Armored, Cavalry, Flying) only work for that movement type; untagged ones (Knightly Senses, Read the Winds, Narrow Defense, Crit Defense, Build+5) work in any class. Skill-rank abilities are assumed to stay equippable after a class change (no source states otherwise).

ability_slots.personal_slot: 1 fixed slot for the character's own ability; cannot be removed (Serenes Forest).
ability_slots.equippable_slots_basis: Player-confirmed in game, Oct 9 2026 (every character has 5). No guide states a slot count. Earlier note '4 in a Beginner class, 5 from Specialty on' is superseded.
ability_slots.class_abilities: Granted automatically by the current class; do not use equippable slots.

how_learned.personal: Innate, fixed in the personal slot, never equippable (for example Cai's Brio).
how_learned.level: Personal level abilities unlock at set levels (usually 20 and 35; some at 5, 45, 50 or 60). They are equippable; a Plus version replaces its base.
how_learned.class: Active only while in the class.
how_learned.mastery: Fill the class's Class EXP gauge by fighting in it; the master ability becomes permanent and equippable in any class (Game8, local class notes).
how_learned.skill_rank: Reaching a skill grade unlocks the ability (Game8). Weapon/magic ladders are universal; Infantry, Heavy Armor and Authority differ per character; Riding and Flying look universal.
how_learned.mount: Bond levels with a mount at the Stable. Automatic while riding it; no slot.

ability_slots.class_exp_notes: No source gives a numeric Class EXP threshold. A GameFAQs player reports mastery is much quicker than in Three Houses.

sources_of_skill_exp.detail: Dagsion Arena (Midtown, east, near the Hightown gate). Unlocks with story progress (Dietrich Ch 5 per RPG Site). Costs no Turn.
On set calendar days, gives Skill EXP to all units; the trained skills vary per match. Time-windowed; check the Calendar.
Auto-Activities > Training at an inn; EXP scales with Turns spent.
Using a weapon type in battle trains it; the class adds its 'trains' bonus (Skill EXP bonus per battle, see class-data.json). Units only level the skills tied to their class.
Attack in a dungeon Clash, then Retreat before the pack dies; Skill EXP is kept and the fight can be repeated. Recovery Link trains White Magic. Magic uses do not refresh on retreat.

Per-weapon 'Increase X EXP' boons add +1 Skill EXP per battle action, rising to +2 and +3 as more Part I paths are completed. They do not affect Arena training. Bought with Karma Shards at the Pale Raven's Perch.
Blessings can raise EXP gained from these methods (details not given).
Consumables that add Skill EXP to one skill. Amount per manual not documented.

arena.costs: Gold plus Motivation. GameRant: 300 gold, 150 on discount. Game8: 50% off on weekends (Sat and Sun); GameRant says Sundays.
arena.limits: Each training option once per week; options refresh weekly. nerdschalk notes you can train Saturday and again after the Sunday reset.
arena.motivation_refund: A Perfect result can refund the Motivation spent (Game8).
arena.support: Units trained together gain Support points.
arena.training_levels: Training Lv 2 at Renown 4 and Lv 3 at Renown 7; higher levels give more Skill EXP (Game8).
arena.exp_per_session: Per skill in the course: Good/Great/Perfect 10/12/15 (Arena Lv 1), 18/21/27 (Lv 2), 25/30/37.5 (Lv 3); boon +7/+12/+17.5, bane no bonus; lower-ranked unit of the pair +5/+9/+12.5 per half rank below its partner, up to 4 half ranks. Community test, read via search snippets.

preferred_and_avoided.rule: Each character has preferred skills (gold on the stat screen; Game8 'Preferred Skills') that rank up faster, and non-ideal skills (purple; Game8 'Non-Ideal Skills') that rank up slower.
preferred_and_avoided.example: Dietrich: preferred Infantry and Sword; non-ideal White Magic (Game8).

exam_pass_rate.known: Pass chance (0-100%) is shown before the exam and comes from the unit's current ranks in the class's primary and secondary skills, plus level versus the tier's Ideal Lv. Colour-coded ranks show shortfalls. Ideal Lv: Beginner 5, Specialty 20, Advanced 35, Master 45; Divine has no ideal level and needs 100%. A failed exam still uses the License; the game autosaves before the result. Aim for 75%+.

mechanics.cost: HP; the amount varies per art. No weapon durability.
mechanics.gauge: Using Blaze Arts fills the Blaze Gauge (shown beside the unit's level). Half full: Overblaze, which boosts stats and Blaze Art power and enables some arts. Full: Burst, which removes all bonuses for the rest of the battle; Underworld-type units also lose max HP (Fextralife and fortunesweave.online say halved).
mechanics.overblaze_threshold: Appears to be 6: Underworld Madness 'Sets Blaze Gauge to 6. Overblaze cannot be removed.' and several arts need gauge 6. Inferred, not stated.

types.Underworld: Default for all units. Cursed Treasures raise the gauge; Burst cuts max HP. Cai, Dietrich, Theodora, Leda, Bertrand, Talimun.
types.Celestial Wells: Normal attacks raise the gauge; Cursed Treasures lower it. Eshmel, Anatolia.
types.Automaton: Cursed Treasures do not raise the gauge. Orchel only; she uses Elizabeth to enter Overblaze.

mechanics.gauge_management: Underworld Calm (Cai, Theodora) resets the gauge to 0. Underworld Madness (Leda, Bertrand) sets it to 6 and locks Overblaze. Elizabeth (Orchel) grants Overblaze once per map.
mechanics.other: Blaze Arts clear miasma on affected tiles. They cannot be used in dungeon Clashes (Game8). 'Underworld Burst' is Cai's opening Blaze Art, not a gauge state.
mechanics.related_abilities: Theodora Direct Hit: +10 damage on Blaze Arts, 30% (Game8 lists Lv 5). Leda Improviso (Lv 35): after using a Blaze Art in Overblaze, can attack. Cai Flamekeeper: immunity to Underworld Flames for unit and allies.
